name: Ersveil
author: Story Suite examples
description: The world of Ersveil: calendar, weather, a map of towns, routes, districts and dungeons, markets and shops, and RPG Battle rules (Guild ranks, peoples and talents, 13 class lines, items, the bestiary, recipes, trainers and Guild jobs), with world events, NPC meter presets and data modules for standing, fame and Guild membership. A new story begins at the Adventurer Guild office in Bluewatch Village.

economy.note: Copper is the small coin: 1 gold = 10 silver = 100 copper. Listed lore prices are Northern Belt town prices and are the baseline; frontier and remote places charge more for imports, Auvoth about double for food and lodging, and goods are cheapest where they are made. About 8 copper to one coin of the built-in defaults.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Silent Cloisters

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Pilgrim Courts

places.name: Isbro

places.name: Kvildal

places.name: Ashpit Cloister

places.name: Quiet Yard

places.name: Stirrup Crossing

places.name: Iron-Blue Tundra

places.name: Hollow Aurora Zone

places.name: Vargate / Factor's Row

places.name: Vargate / Tolerated Ward

places.name: Glassmouth

places.name: Ashkar

places.name: Ashkar / Regent's Mirror

places.name: Ashkar / Bright Market

places.name: Ashkar / Pit Road

places.name: Briarhorn Labyrinth

places.name: Wolfcairn Deeps

places.name: Saint Orven's Drowned Cloister

places.name: Deepmantle Hollow
places.note: Clan-sealed high dungeon of living stone and sealed golems. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Echo Sink

places.name: Pilgrim's Descent

places.name: Witchwood Rootwell

places.name: Fallen Meridian Vault

places.name: Chain-Eater Pit

places.name: Redglass Labyrinth

places.name: Rootbound Observatory

races.name: Human
races.note: The most numerous people; short, hard lives, often sixty years. No stat change.

races.name: Elf
races.note: Lives three to five centuries; physically adult in their twenties, socially about fifty.

races.name: Dwarf
races.note: Lives around two centuries; holds, clans, oaths and grudges.

races.name: Halfling
races.note: Lives about a century; river-town barges, kitchens and ledgers.

races.name: Beastfolk
races.note: Animal ears, tails, fur or horns and keen senses; lives fifty to seventy years.

races.name: Orc
races.note: Large and strong; lives about fifty years; vilified, citizens only in Ardelia.

races.name: Goblin
races.note: Small and quick; lives about forty years; unnoticed until too late.

races.name: Spiritfolk
races.note: A spirit people in semi-physical forms of their own mana; they do not age, but can be wounded, drained and unmade.

races.name: Fairy
races.note: Tiny (10-20 cm), insect-winged, bound to a personal flower; Flower-Speech magic.

races.name: Sea Folk
races.note: Atlanteans; breathe underwater through a membranous sheath; live about a century and a half.

talents.name: Physical Affinity
talents.note: The common affinity: mana pushed inward to reinforce strength, speed and toughness.

talents.name: Mana Affinity
talents.note: The rarer affinity: mana projected outward as magic.

talents.name: Deep Vessel
talents.note: A soul of deep innate capacity: faster growth and a higher plateau, learned over years of strain.

talents.name: Fire Attunement
talents.note: The soul's mana leans toward the fire attribute; Listeners hear it as a pitch.

talents.name: Frost Attunement
talents.note: The soul's mana leans toward the frost attribute.

talents.name: Lightning Attunement
talents.note: The soul's mana leans toward the lightning attribute.

talents.name: Shadow Attunement
talents.note: The soul's mana leans toward the shadow attribute.

talents.name: Otherworlder
talents.note: From another world: absorbs nearly all of a nearby death's release and grows fast; hunted by the Inquest, prized by slavers, feared by all. Only if the persona says so.

items.name: Trail Rations

items.name: Winter Clothing

items.name: Heavy Sword

items.name: Katana

items.name: Antique Katana
items.note: A collector's piece; a fence pays a third.

items.name: Bo-shuriken (5)
items.note: Throwing spikes of an otherworlder lineage.

items.name: Farm Cart
items.note: Needs an animal to pull it.

items.name: Storage Pouch
items.note: Holds only nonliving matter; customs may seal or search it.

items.name: Storage Ring
items.note: Counts while worn; holds only nonliving matter.

items.name: Cleansing Spirits
items.note: For wounds and glassware.

items.name: Minor Healing Potion
items.note: Closes wounds; leaves weakness and a scar.

items.name: Mana-Sickness Remedy
items.note: For overchanneling, deep delving or dense-mana sickness.

items.name: Completion Salts
items.note: Licensed salt-and-iron mix that seals one body; cut salts fail.

items.name: Webweaver Venom
items.note: Paralytic.

items.name: Blight Wasp Stinger
items.note: Rots flesh.

items.name: Mite Crystal
items.note: Mana crystal from a crystal-mite nest.

items.name: Glassling Shell
items.note: Glass-steel stock.

items.name: Great Beast Carcass
items.note: Meat, hide and bone of a large beast; sells for at least an ox.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.note: Burns; propels nothing.

items.name: Ward Charm
items.note: A cracked mana stone set in a cut iron ward.

items.name: Cooling Box
items.note: Keeps salvage from rotting on the way out.

meters.name: Loyalty
meters.describe: Whether they stay when staying costs them.

meters.name: Fear
meters.describe: How much of their obedience is fear of you; it fades when not fed.

meters.name: Debt
meters.describe: Who owes whom: wages behind, a life saved, a bond bought. Debts come due at Yearsend.

stages.name: Deserter in waiting
stages.milestone: They are only waiting for a safe road to leave.

stages.name: Sworn retainer
stages.milestone: They would hold the line beside you, paid or not.

meters.name: Trust
meters.describe: How far this contact believes you; strangers start a little below even.

meters.name: Owed favours
meters.describe: Favours outstanding: positive, they owe you; negative, you owe them. Old favours are remembered for a while.

stages.name: Informant
stages.milestone: They start passing you what they hear before others do.

stages.name: Sold you out
stages.milestone: Your name has been sold to someone who pays better.

deed.refusal: Deeds need witnesses: a deed nobody lived to tell earns no fame. Write witnessed: true only when someone saw it.

spread.refusal: News spreads from one region to another; name two different regions.

register.refusal: Already registered: everyone registers once and starts at F.

dues.refusal: Register at a Guild hall first.

contract.refusal: Only a registered member works Guild contracts.

promote.refusal: Register first; an examiner panel sets the letter.

yearend.refusal: The Guild year only turns for a registered member.

classes.name: Awakened
classes.note: Every soul awakens to Soul Class I by adolescence; everyone starts here, before any school. At level 10 the soul chooses its line.

classes.name: Man-at-Arms
classes.note: Levy turned career soldier or veteran watchman, Soul Class II: paid, drilled and still alive.

classes.name: Iron Guard Sergeant
classes.note: Iron Guard Academy drill: formation, lance and heavy sword, breathing drilled until the body breaks or holds.

classes.name: Iron Guard Knight
classes.note: Knight of the Iron Guard: officer, lancer and champion of the Highmark line.

classes.name: Hall Shieldbearer
classes.note: Sworn to a Hammerfall shield hall: carries the shield, learns the wall, keeps the clan's oaths.

classes.name: Hammerfall Oathshield
classes.note: Shield hall of Hammerfall: dwarven shieldwall and axe, clan-based and oath-bound, unbreakable in tunnels.

classes.name: Hammerfall Holdfast
classes.note: Holdfast of the Hammerfall halls: the shield the clan stands behind when the dark road opens.

classes.name: House Fencer
classes.note: Paying pupil of a Mirage City duelling house; Daubrey or Lisle, never both.

classes.name: House Duellist
classes.note: Member of a Mirage City duelling house: lessons sold, judicial duels fought, rivals hated for a century.

classes.name: Judicial Champion
classes.note: Champion hired to fight judicial duels; some learn an otherworlder blade lineage and draw the Inquest's eye.

classes.name: Pit Hand
classes.note: Knifeglass Alley pit school fighter, slave or desperate volunteer: dirty, effective and still breathing.

classes.name: Knifeglass Gladiator
classes.note: Graduate of the Knifeglass pits: sold to a stable or fighting toward freedom.

classes.name: Pit Champion
classes.note: Champion of the Shackles pits: pit fighters kill soldiers and duellists alike.

classes.name: Breath Disciple
classes.note: Novice of the Snowbell Breath School at Kvildal: unarmoured, cold, slow to learn.

classes.name: Snowbell Monk
classes.note: Monk of the Snowbell Breath School, the north's purest reinforcement breathing: terrifying in a fight.

classes.name: Snowbell Breath Master
classes.note: Master of Snowbell breath: no armour, no weapon, no need.

classes.name: Lodge Tracker
classes.note: Hunter who survived the first hunt of a Longstride lodge: tracks, snares and the short bow.

classes.name: Longstride Hunter
classes.note: Hunter of the Longstride lodges: tracking, ambush, spear, bow, monster lore; outsiders who survive the first hunt.

classes.name: Lodge Huntmaster
classes.note: Huntmaster of a Longstride lodge: leads the great hunts and hears what the herds will do.

classes.name: Drill-Yard Recruit
classes.note: Recruit of the Guild drill yards in Auvoth or Delver's Crown: cheap training, full of the soon-dead.

classes.name: Drill-Yard Delver
classes.note: Graduate of the Guild drill yards of Auvoth and Delver's Crown: tunnel formations, trap work, retreat drills.

classes.name: Deep-Band Delver
classes.note: Veteran of the deeper bands: knows what a seal sounds like before it breaks.

classes.name: Stalker
classes.note: Hand of Oblivion stalker; most start as a broker's cutthroat, then learn to follow a target for days.

classes.name: Shadow Blade
classes.note: A blade the Hand trusts with protected targets.

classes.name: Executor
classes.note: Independent Executor of the Hand of Oblivion: chooses the contract, honours it once taken.

classes.name: Infiltrator
classes.note: Nightingale infiltrator: cosh, disguise, locks and the back door of every great house; no needless murder.

classes.name: Phantom
classes.note: Nightingale phantom: core specialist in theft and intelligence, never seen twice the same.

classes.name: Grand Redistributor
classes.note: Master of the Nightingale: wealth only gains meaning when it is in motion.

classes.name: Spell Student
classes.note: Student of spell grammar at Startrace or with a private tutor, by fee or by scholarship and its debts.

classes.name: Journeyman Spellwright
classes.note: Journeyman of spell grammar: projected elemental and force spells; those who rush get burned.

classes.name: Startrace Master
classes.note: Master of Startrace Tower: knowledge without restraint becomes another dungeon.

classes.name: Rune Apprentice
classes.note: Apprentice in an artificer workshop or the Rune Halls of Oathvault: fixed patterns, cut slowly and paid for in materials.

classes.name: Oathvault Runecarver
classes.note: Runecarver of the Rune Halls of Oathvault: wards, locks, mana-stone devices; materials and time are the price.

classes.name: Rune Master
classes.note: Rune master of the Ironanvil Holds: the patterns hold because stone remembers them.

classes.name: Acolyte
classes.note: Acolyte of the Church of the Eternal Flame: trained for obedience and service.

classes.name: Flame Cleric
classes.note: Cleric of the Church flamecraft: consecrated fire, completion rites, wards against the restless dead.

classes.name: Inquest Flamecaller
classes.note: Flamecaller of the Church Inquest: hunts necromancers and Veil cells; hears death frequency before the dead rise.

classes.name: Hospice Novice
classes.note: Novice of a temple or hospice ward, or a village wise-woman's pupil: every healing tires the healer.

classes.name: Hospice Healer
classes.note: Healer of a temple or hospice: closes wounds, purges poison, treats mana sickness; it exhausts the healer.

classes.name: Grove Healer
classes.note: Healer taught in the Grove Schools of Elenvar or Verdantleaf; it never restores the dead or lost limbs.

skills.name: Strike
skills.note: One honest blow with whatever is in hand.

skills.name: Reinforcement Breathing
skills.note: Physical Affinity: mana pushed inward for strength; drilled bodies wear out early.

skills.name: Kindling Spark
skills.note: Mana Affinity: a spark of fire mana pushed out of the hand; it fades as it lands.

skills.name: Shield and Spear
skills.note: Strike from behind the rim, never leave cover.

skills.name: Formation Step
skills.note: The line moves as one and holds as one.

skills.name: Overhand Cut
skills.note: A heavy downward cut with everything behind it.

skills.name: Pressure Cut
skills.note: At Soul Class III the edge throws cutting pressure a few paces past itself.

skills.name: Lance Charge
skills.note: Couched lance, full weight, one target.

skills.name: Drill Command
skills.note: The sergeant's voice puts the line back together.

skills.name: Knight's Lance
skills.note: The charge the Academy is built around.

skills.name: Blade Pressure
skills.note: At Soul Class IV the cut carries about ten paces: a feat of speed, not a spell.

skills.name: Iron Discipline
skills.note: Rank holds because the knight holds.

skills.name: Brace the Line
skills.note: Plant the feet, shield up, wait for the charge.

skills.name: Take the Hit
skills.note: Breath held, shield set, the blow taken on purpose.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.note: The rim of the shield to the face.

skills.name: Shield Oath
skills.note: Every shield in the wall is sworn to the next.

skills.name: Tunnel Wall
skills.note: Shield locked to shield across the width of a tunnel.

skills.name: Hold-Axe Chop
skills.note: A short axe swung low from behind the shield.

skills.name: Unbreakable Wall
skills.note: The wall does not break; it is the wall.

skills.name: Stone Remembers
skills.note: An axe blow for every grudge the clan keeps.

skills.name: Oath of the Hold
skills.note: Sworn on the hold's name: no step back.

skills.name: Fencer's Lunge
skills.note: The first lesson the houses sell.

skills.name: Feint
skills.note: The blade goes left, the opponent goes wrong.

skills.name: En Garde
skills.note: Guard up, weight forward, waiting.

skills.name: Daubrey Lunge
skills.note: House Daubrey's fast single sword: one line, no wasted motion.

skills.name: Lisle Sword-and-Dagger
skills.note: House Lisle: the sword engages, the dagger finishes.

skills.name: Riposte
skills.note: Parry first, answer at once.

skills.name: Judicial Thrust
skills.note: The thrust that ends a lawsuit.

skills.name: Draw-Cut
skills.note: Iaijutsu from an otherworlder lineage: the cut lands as the blade leaves the sheath.

skills.name: Champion's Guard
skills.note: A guard that waits for the mistake.

skills.name: Sand in the Eyes
skills.note: A fistful of arena sand, then the blade.

skills.name: Hamstring
